title: Administration (Intestacy Legacy Amounts) Order 2025
made_under: Administration Act 1903 (WA) s 14A(2): Minister's order declaring the sums for the specified items in the s 14 Table (items 2, 3(a) and (b), 3(b)(i), 6)
published_in: Western Australian Government Gazette, 4 July 2025, p. 1114 (as listed in endnote 8 of the Administration Act 1903 consolidation deposited at subjects/au/wa/administration-act-1903/); it replaced the Administration (Intestacy Legacy Amounts) Order 2023 (Gazette 1 Aug 2023 p. 2691-2)
located: cited by the Act's own endnote; the Gazette issue itself was not downloaded
notes: Index entry only. Indexed in place of the 'Administration Regulations 1913' named in the WA lives plan: no instrument of that name is in the WA in-force subsidiary legislation list, and the s 14 spouse-legacy amounts are now set in the Act's Table (s 14) and varied by Minister's order under s 14A, published in the Gazette. The Gazette is excluded from the WA Legislation website's CC BY 4.0 licence.
